subject.title: fix: serialize outbound deliveries per channel+recipient

question: Should this draft be repaired in place as a canonical durable delivery-lane change, replaced by a narrower maintainer-owned patch, or left for the contributor to rework?
rationale: The bug and proof are strong, but the safe fix crosses durable queue ordering, canonical target resolution, and channel stall behavior; that is a merge-risk choice rather than a tiny mechanical edit.

options.title: Repair canonical lane before merge
options.body: Rework this PR or a replacement around a pre-enqueue canonical delivery lane using the existing keyed queue and bounded abort/stall semantics.

options.title: Accept the current serializer risk
options.body: Land the branch as-is and intentionally own the remaining raw-key, post-enqueue ordering, and head-of-line blocking risks.

options.title: Pause or replace the draft
options.body: Keep this draft waiting on author or open a narrow replacement if maintainers want the bug fixed without preserving this branch shape.
